scripts.dev: npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/shared && concurrently --kill-others --success first "npm run watch -w @clash-sentinel/shared" "npm run dev -w @clash-sentinel/server" "npm run dev -w @clash-sentinel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/shared && npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/server && npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/web
scripts.test:prototype: npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/shared && playwright test --config playwright.prototype.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @clash-sentinel/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
